description: For one USCIS form (I-485 unless asked), the sample's online filings by the month USCIS received them, newest first. Each month gives the share approved, the share sent an evidence request and the share still waiting, with a 95% margin. A month's newest cases are the least decided, so its share approved climbs as the month ages. Example: {"form":"I-485"}.

form.description: A USCIS form, like I-485, I-765 or I-130. I-485 when left out. Example: I-485.
